intro: From weekday dinners to weekend gatherings, Kalyx effortlessly blends elegance with everyday comfort. Designed for modern living, it adapts to your home and your lifestyle—one seat, endless possibilities.

features.title: Versatile design that adapts to your space
features.text: Whether for everyday meals or elegant gatherings, the Kalyx chair adapts to any setting, offering versatility and style that suits every occasion.

features.title: High-quality fabric upholstery for comfort
features.text: Soft and durable fabric upholstery provides lasting comfort, allowing you to dine in style without compromising on quality.

features.title: Elegant design for sophisticated look
features.text: With its elegant design, the Kalyx chair adds a refined touch to your dining area, seamlessly blending with various interior themes.

features.title: Power coated metal legs
features.text: The sturdy, power-coated metal legs ensure durability and a sleek, modern finish that enhances the chair’s overall aesthetic.

features.title: Knock-down construction with easy assembly
features.text: Designed for convenience, the Kalyx chair features knock-down construction for easy transport and quick, hassle-free assembly. Ideal for any modern home.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
